title: Bank of England: Hawkish hold risks and November hike – MUFG
summary: MUFG’s Henry Cook expects the Bank of England to deliver a hawkish hold, with UK inflation driven higher by energy and headline CPI projected to exceed 4% after the January price cap reset.

title: Federal Reserve set to raise interest rate after five meetings on hold
summary: The United States (US) Federal Reserve (Fed) announces its interest rate decision on Wednesday, following another pivotal meeting that could provide key insights into the monetary policy outlook heading into the end of the year.

title: Eurozone: Manufacturing outlook steadies as year-end hopes build – ING
summary: ING’s Bert Colijn notes that Eurozone industrial production slipped by 0.1% in both June and July, leaving output broadly unchanged from a year earlier. He highlights resilience in capital goods and energy, but continued weakness in consumer-focused sectors, especially non-durable goods.

title: Euro trades cautiously against US Dollar ahead of expected Fed rate hike
summary: EUR/USD consolidates losses on Wednesday as traders avoid taking strong directional positions ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement.
